in_sanskrit.name: किन्नरक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who sings the praises of the Devas

in_marathi.name: Kinnarak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kinnarak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kinnarak refers to the divine musician or bard. They are celestial beings with extraordinary musical skills, often depicted playing string instruments like the veena or the mridangam.
